Reference / http/robots

http/robots#

robots.txt (RFC 9309): what a crawler may fetch.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let policy = await FetchedRobots(origin: HttpClient(), site: ParsedUrl("https://example.com/").parts(), agent: "okkabot").policy();
policy.allowed("okkabot", ParsedUrl("https://example.com/private/x").parts());
RobotsPolicy(text).sitemaps();

Description#

robots.txt (RFC 9309): what a crawler may fetch.

The longest matching rule wins, Allow on a tie. A missing robots.txt (4xx) allows everything; a server error (5xx) allows nothing. Files are bounded to 512 KiB.
